notes.title: War of Wheels first update!
notes.content:
Hey riders!

We are happy to announce the first patch for War of Wheels!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/cee459ead6df6c23358735921eb69ae06d82ac4a.gif"]



A huge thank you to all the players who decided to try our game! In recent days we have received invaluable feedback, which we will take into great consideration for future updates.

This first patch fixes several bugs and introduces some quality of life features to make driving in the arenas easier and improve vehicle customization. We have also made an initial balancing to increase the combat effectiveness of some weapons, in particular those of the artificer. Finally, a couple of new decorations for your cars.



You may find all the update informations in the patch changelog.



We are working hard on the next content, some of which will arrive very soon… we can't wait to show it to you!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337940/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: War of Wheels is out in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey riders!

We’re excited to announce that War of Wheels is now officially in Early Access! 🎉
We’ve been working hard to bring the first phase of the game to life, and here’s what's available at launch:

 🔥 Single-Player and split-scren multiplayer Arena Mode – Face off in intense battles where only the toughest survive.
  🚗 5 Unique Vehicles – Each class has its own strengths, weapons, and combat style.
  🌆🏜️ 2 Biomes to Dominate – Fight in the City of Galvinor or the sun-scorched Desert.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/2085039224387e4f2b994504bbb21d4159e2bd2c.gif
What’s Coming Next?
We’re just getting started! Here’s what’s on the horizon:

❄️ Arctic Biome Update – A new frozen battlefield will be added in the coming months.
🔧 More Vehicles & Customization – New car classes, skins, and upgrades based on your feedback.
🌍 Multiplayer Expansion – Multiplayer modes will roll out before the full release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/13a40f79c455a78c3ad3adef4286b5af6333ef9f.gif
Why Early Access?
With War of Wheels, we want to create the ultimate medievalpunk combat experience, and Early Access allows us to shape the game alongside you, our players.
This first phase focuses on refining combat mechanics and introducing core gameplay elements before expanding into online multiplayer and new game modes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/dfdb487b6e5a5ca07b71ce470beb66ffe908551b.jpg

Get Involved!
We want War of Wheels to evolve with the community, and your feedback will shape the game! Share your thoughts and let us know what features you’d love to see.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337940/War_of_Wheels/

We can’t wait for you to hit the battlefield. See you in the arena! 🚗💥
— The War of Wheels Dev Team

notes.title: We’re Back! New Demo, Festival News & What’s Next for War of Wheels
notes.content:
Hello Riders,

We know it's been a while—and we really appreciate your patience. Over the past months, we’ve been hard at work refining War of Wheels based on your feedback and making sure the game becomes everything we’ve envisioned (and more).

Today, we’re excited to finally share a few major updates:

🛠️ New Demo Available NOW
We’ve just released a new and improved demo of War of Wheels! With updated mechanics, improved performance, and refined visuals, this version reflects many of the changes we’ve made thanks to your input. Go try it out and let us know what you think!

🎉 We’re Part of Indie Assemble Festival!
We’re proud to be featured in the Indie Assemble Festival—a celebration of great indie titles and fresh creative voices. This is a huge milestone for our team and we’re thrilled to be showcasing the game alongside so many awesome projects.

🔮 More News Coming Soon
This is just the beginning. We’ve got exciting announcements lined up—including new content reveals and development updates—so keep an eye on this page and our socials. You won’t want to miss what’s coming next.

Thanks again for sticking with us. The War of Wheels community is small but mighty, and we can’t wait to hit the road with you all.

💥 Play the new demo and share your feedback in the Community Hub!

— The Dreambits Studio Team

notes.title: Coming Soon: New Demo is on the way!
notes.content:
An army on 4 wheels!

Greetings to all of you, brave war riders! We saw that so many flocked to try out War of Wheels during the Lucca Comics & Games exhibition: seeing you speeding and fighting while having fun can only be a source of pride and excitement for us, thank you all!



New content coming soon

Therefore, we would like to announce that we will soon release a new demo with content that will further enrich the War of Wheels experience!

Local multiplayer 

You will finally be able to fight against your comrades-in-arms inside the arenas, thanks to the inclusion of a local multiplayer mode equipped with split screen: dashing side by side will give a whole new flavor to your fights!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/535bf7ecfd950ad593519d9366e1919d990b3b1d.gif


Fight in the Desert Arena

Arcade mode will see the addition of a deadly new battlefield: the arid desert arena will see the most fearless war riders among you fighting inside it!
It will also be available for local Multiplayer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/72e634192bada7d3929946f9739d7ab6b44dea68.gif


New class: the Assassin

The roster of available vehicles is ready to welcome a new and deadly competitor: the Assassin, with its extreme speed, is now ready to take to the track in the arenas of Arcade and Local Multiplayer modes! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/bad68eaa4f13fb3414d4bdb7c4f3d600a12f2689.gif


What's new for Story mode: Tutorial and Quests

One thing we care a lot about is that you are introduced to the realm of Zeranthia as clearly as possible, so we have included a tutorial that can properly guide you to the operation at each game feature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/5db4df5e5f74ae7a998c0829f549bdf15b8ff1cf.gif


Zeranthia, moreover, will welcome you with varied quests to perform, in addition to the main quest you have been able to experience so far, and you can keep track of them thanks to the new quest log and journal: in short, the quest system has been completely revamped!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/74b3ff1386c6edf0e3cbdda6e2b10de8a9e52240.gif


 Local multiplayer with split screen (2 players);
 New Map for Arcade and Local Multiplayer: Desert Arena
 New playable vehicle: the Assassin;
 Insertion of introductory tutorial for Story mode;
 Quest system: new quests, quest log and journal.

We can't wait for you to experience each of these new features firsthand, we will keep you updated!

notes.title: New biome: the Arctic realm (WIP)
notes.content:
North of the central lands of Zeranthia, past the impassable snow-white peaks, one can reach the icy Arctic realm, an inhospitable region where only the indomitable Barbarian tribes manage to dwell without succumbing!


 North of the central territories lies the Arctic realm!


A wilderness of snow and ice

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/1936bee68c4fb50028b91896503c9b73ec2476c7.png

The northern realm is home to a vast frozen lake above which to whiz; villages are located on airships crashed and embedded in rock walls, and the elevated areas are plagued by perennial blizzards that blur the vision of any rider who travels through them.


 Cross and explore the frozen lake at the center of the realm;
 Visit villages near the mountain walls;
 Beware of blizzards in the higher terrain...ye may run into danger without spotting them in time!
 To escape the hostilities of such a scenario, ye can return to the central lands via the Avioport!


Deadly new battlegrounds

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/d468e8b967b8379d0bb7d5c2d6e16c77b5719268.png

Brave riders who choose to cross the icy realm are sure to run into the fearsome Barbarians! The battlefields are among the most diverse: from graveyards of ruined airships, to moors battered by snowstorms, to winding forests of bare trees.


 Fight and survive against the deadly vehicles of the Barbarians!
 New battlefields: airship graveyards, blizzard-stricken areas, and barren tree forests.


Prove your worth to the northern warriors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/aee910b4ac6d9762571b8cdc4c3f396711ad94fb.png

Even the outposts are mostly in the hands of the Barbarian clans, who, being thirsty for blood and steel, have also established massive fighting arenas, taking advantage of the morphology and features of the terrain on which they are erected.


 Take part in even more extreme gladiatorial games: the arenas of the North await ye!


If ye are daring drivers worthy of the name, the Northern lands will know how to offer ye new heart-pounding challenges...but never let your guard down or your vehicles will become yet another wreck buried in the ice!

notes.title: Devlog: the Barbarian class (WIP)
New update: News about Aesthetics and Controls
notes.content:
Greetings to ye, O brave War Riders! We have important news to tell ye regarding the aesthetics of your vehicles and also a new feature requested by ye warriors to have more control over your war chariots.


 News about vehicle aesthetics and controls customization!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/ffa45380539208b99a636e41ced9cef1a29d151c.png

More and more majestic vehicles: new decorations!

The most creative of artisans throughout the realm continued to forge fine ornaments, mostly using precious minerals and creating new crystalline shapes that could add further luster to your combat vehicles.


 Visit the Garages of Zeranthia and adorn your vehicles with exquisite new decorations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/771967bc40ce2caede492f55504ac2487f49a946.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/f853a8b5a45945127cf083741937d92ed9ca0179.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/a8ebe939c5955034ee12e188e6ce05717dde0fd0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/c705d35cfddc2aefcec97850b8afc6e36360a484.png



Modify the controls according to your will!

As requested by some of ye, we have introduced the possibility to modify the controls related to vehicle movement and functionality, to provide each rider with greater freedom over the control exercised over their vehicles


 Access the Options and modify the Game Inputs to your liking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/ce021ecffb3416e2e5810d75849b36c6dc0d79c4.gif



Coming soon: news about Campaign Mode

Be prepared for salient news in the near future, we are setting up for ye a new and more elaborate tutorial to introduce ye to the moors of Zeranthia, as well as a new quest system that will allow ye to gradually experience the epic chronicles of the realm

Coming soon: new quest system, with the addition of a new quest log and a new quest journal.

notes.title: Campaign: Pitched Battles
notes.content:
Adrenaline-pumping fights in the open field

The presence of fierce bandits in the lands of Zeranthia forces every war rider to be battle-ready at all times, facing armies of enemy vehicles in adrenaline-fueled open-field battles: it is up to ye, O valiant pilots, to decide whether to evade the marauders infesting the realm or face them for glory and valuable materials.


 Confront or avoid dangerous bandits, lurking in every corner of the kingdom;
 Defeat opposing troops to gain fame and useful materials for your vehicle.


Different battlegrounds

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/99eec50441aa75064dd887d83a7abba3ad992016.gif

The moors of Zeranthia offer different types of terrain on which to clash: from hurtling down the side of a hill, charging headlong into opposing vehicles on vast plains or swerving nimbly through the trees of a forest, each conflict requires adapting to the terrain in which it takes place.


 Ye must adapt to the environment in which the battle is waged, whether it is flat, hilly, or dotted with trees;
 (Coming soon) As ye push into the more distant lands of Zeranthia, ye will unearth new biomes that will offer varied types of natural arenas.


Fierce armies of vehicles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/e1496b3e048b19264299a7cd68aaaaa6d4869012.gif

Platoons of marauders infesting Zeranthia can vary in number; it is essential to enlist valiant warriors to flank ye and fight for ye, thus granting ye an advantage that will prove vital to the battle.


 Enlist allied vehicles to gain advantage in combat;
 Allied war pilots fight alongside ye, eliminating enemy vehicles.


The last way out: Escape

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/335e9fd1665ceede8cec67606d0f7cd4c620cbfc.gif

If the situation is critical and the confrontation is about to come to an outcome unfavorable to ye, there is always the option of abandoning the battlefield; such an action, being dishonorable, will lead to the diminution of your reputation among the inhabitants of Zeranthia.


 In case the enemy army is gaining the upper hand, it is best to flee immediately;
 After making an escape, your fame with the kingdom will drop.


Traveling through the moors of Zeranthia means always having to be prepared for a deadly confrontation on any terrain...dash with your army to victory!

notes.title: Customization: News from Garage and Cosmetics
notes.content:
Adorn your war chariot

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/d8d462b288166b4a8037c3405d35efa09ae7cd83.gif

Among War Riders, there has long been a custom of enhancing the aesthetics of one's vehicle with extravagant ornaments and accessories with a mystical flavor;
It is up to you to choose the most appropriate decorations, whether you want to make your vehicle elegant or prefer to give it a more warlike appearance.


 Adorn your vehicle! You can do this by visiting any of Zeranthia's Garages;
 Choose the decorations that best suit your style.


Be amazed by new creations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/d8e0af7b8d3fb392b520f2579641df86a314d686.gif

Compared to the early years of the War of Wheels, in which decorations were far more crude and rudimentary, the need has arisen to want to cover one's chariot with more lavish ornaments; numerous artisans throughout Zeranthia are making various ornaments of this type, and many more will see the light of day in the future.


 Cover your chariot with new and lavish ornaments;
 (Coming Soon) Magnificent accessories are currently under construction at Zeranthia workshops.


New possibilities for decorating vehicles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/ec839925901e87546f17c83cad246830dba4d57a.gif

Thanks to the extraordinary craftsmanship of the artisans and the efficiency of the Garages, you can freely alter the size of ornaments or change their rotation before embedding them on the bodywork; you can even make “mirror” copies to go along with the original decorations.


 Enlarge or shrink your ornaments to your liking;
 Freely modify the rotation of the trimmings;
 Create perfectly mirrored copies of any ornament.



For a War Rider, it is not only important to be armed, but it is essential to display one's chariot in the most unique and spectacular way possible!

notes.title: Campaign: Map and Exploration
notes.content:
Explore every corner of the kingdom!
The kingdom of Zeranthia offers a varied territory in which war drivers speed, visiting the numerous outposts and exploring the mysterious ruins... but be careful: on the streets it is possible to come across dangerous groups of bandits and assassins!

Travel freely throughout the kingdom of Zeranthia:

 Visit the many outposts that populate the regions;
 (Coming Soon) Explore the enigmatic ruins of Aether;
 Face or avoid the dangerous marauders that prowl the streets!



Zeranthia morphology
The territory presents winding hilly areas, vast plains and dense forests; while the central area of ​​Zeranthia is mostly green, it is said that there are also the freezing arctic realm and the scorching volcanic realm… will you be able to reach them?



 Follow routes scattered across hilly areas, vast plains and enormous forests;
 Push yourself beyond the boundaries of the known and reach the arctic and volcanic realms.


Stop and resupply at the outposts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/d20a3fc0ac349a0cfb8db4f157c4594fffbadb2e.gif

During the War of Wheels, outposts arose in every corner of the kingdom: it is possible to come across humble villages, fortified provinces and even very rich inhabited centers: the capitals; visit all sorts of outposts to be able to make use of the peculiar services they offer.


 Visit every kind of outpost: villages, provinces and capitals;
 Each type of outpost offers different services to the drivers who stop there.


Delve into the ruins…
Coming Soon
The ruins constitute the most arcane places in the kingdom... It's here that it is possible to extract the most important and profitable mineral of every era: the crystal called Aether! However, it is said that such sites are often a destination for the most greedy raiders of Zeranthia…


 In the ruins it’s possible to obtain the magical Aether crystals;
 The ruins are often prey to greedy bandits to deal with.


Watch your back!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/c98b0b5ec258a6318c94905aa3c952b9e2ec1be1.gif

Never let your guard down, brave driver: when you least expect it you could come across dangerous enemy vehicles! Choose whether to face the hostile group of bandits or avoid all risks and escape.


 The streets of Zeranthia are filled with the vehicles of treacherous raiders;
 Rush into an enemy and face his army or run away!




As you have seen, Zeranthia can be fascinating with its natural wonders and welcoming with its city centers... but don't underestimate the threats that lurk around the corner!

notes.title: Thanks for the support
notes.content:
Welcome to the War of Wheels demo! War of Wheels is a fast-paced car combat game in an original "medievalpunk" setting.
In this demo it is possible to play an "Arcade" type game in single player against bots, or in "Story" mode, with arena fights (similar to Arcade mode), with the addition of a freely explorable map and open field battles and with the possibility of trying the initial quest of the campaign.
New arenas will be added soon for the Arcade and new explorable biomes with related combat maps for the Story mode.



STARTING A GAME

To start a game, select PLAY and choose ARCADE SINGLEPLAYER or STORY. In the case of both options, the game begins immediately when they are selected.

SINGLE PLAYER ARCADE 
This mode consists of an arena deathmatch between 8 competitors (1 player + 7 bots) in which the winner is the one who kills the most and suffers the fewest deaths within 5 minutes.
Before selecting ARCADE SINGLEPLAYER, you must choose your car by pressing the GARAGE button from the top menu and selecting the class icon (those currently playable are Knight and Ranger).
In the arena there are both traps to avoid, such as fire traps and explosive barrels, and consumable barrels to heal yourself.
STORY
The kingdom of Zeranthia, following the War of Wheels, is subjugated by the Emperor, but combat vehicles have spread throughout the realm: be the first driver to change history!
The campaign features a fully explorable strategic map from which missions can be carried out to advance the story.
"Outposts" of different types are scattered throughout the map, where you can purchase or build new weapons, recruit your own units and modify your vehicle; you can also participate in the Gladiator Games at the Arenas.
Finally, by exploring the map, it is possible to come across the "Marauders", enemy vehicles that can be faced in open field battles, where you can fight alongside your army.


CUSTOMIZE YOUR CAR

You can select one of the available classes by pressing the GARAGE button from the top menu and clicking on the class icon. By selecting the CUSTOMIZE button you will be able to modify the weapons from the WEAPONS panel and the aesthetics from the COSMETICS panel. Each time you make a change, press SAVE to save the current configuration.

At any time you can press Right/Left Arrow or WASD to rotate the car (Xbox controller: you can rotate the car via Left Analog Stick or D-pad Right-Left), press Up/Down Arrow or A-D to zoom on car ( Xbox Controller: D-Pad Up-Down) and press Left Shift to show/hide the UI (Xbox Controller: Left Analog stick click).
You can add one or more custom decorations by clicking "Cosmetics" in the COSMETICS panel, choosing the decoration and placing it on the car with the Mouse (Xbox Controller: Right Analog stick). In positioning mode, you can rotate the car by pressing Left/Right Arrow or WASD (Xbox controller: Left Analog Stick or Left/Right Arrow).
Clicking the equipped decoration icon again allows you to remove it.
It is also possible to perform the following operations on the decorations: Scale - Rotate - Mirror (see command list at the bottom of the guide to learn the shortcuts).


THE CLASSES

The currently playable classes are the Knight (in ARCADE SINGLEPLAYER and STORY) and the Ranger (only in ARCADE SINGLEPLAYER);
Knight: Balanced class, prefers close combat. His passive skill allows him to inflict massive damage on enemies when he reaches high speed and hits with his melee weapons: spears, blades and hammer (the spears start to glow and leave a trail). His active skill allows him to protect himself, negating damage for a short period of time.
Ranger: balanced class with high speed, prefers ranged combat. His passive ability makes him immune to traps. The active ability allows him to heal himself instantly.

NOTE: During combat, you can slash with a melee weapon by pressing the weapon's button. If you hold down the button, the weapon (except for the “War Hammer”) is drawn and deals damage when it comes into contact with an enemy. When a weapon is drawn you cannot attack with other weapons;
You cannot use more than one weapon at a time.




GAME CONTROLS

[To play we recommend using the controller]

KEYBOARD

COMBAT Controls (Arcade and Story)

WASD: Move car
Left mouse button: Use weapon 1
Right mouse button: Use weapon 2
Middle mouse button: Use weapon 3
Spacebar: Handbrake
Altleft + Mouse/4-6(numpad): Move camera
8-2 (numpad): Rear view

Left Shift: Use turbo 
Left CTRL: Use the class's primary skill

TAB: Player Rankings (Arcade only)
ESC: Opens the pause menu


EXPLORATION Controls (Story)

Left mouse button: Move car/Select
Mouse: Move cursor
Right/left arrow: move camera right/left
Up/down arrow: zoom in/out
ESC: Opens the pause menu
P: Pauses the game


CUSTOMIZATION Controls (Menu > Garage)

A-D/Left-Right arrow keys: Car Rotation
Mouse Left button: Place/Remove Decoration
Mouse wheel: Zoom car
Left Shift: Toggle UI
Mouse: Move decoration
Left ctrl + WASD/Q-E: Rotate decoration
Left ctrl + Mouse Right button: Mirror decoration
Left ctrl + Mouse wheel: Scale decoration


Debug Buttons (Arcade and Story COMBAT)

J: Activation of the user interface
K: music selection
L: Toggle SFX
P: Self-destruction
T: Teleport to spawn point



CONTROLLER (Xbox)

COMBAT Controls (Arcade and Story)

Left analog stick: Move car.
LT: Use weapon 1
LB: Use weapon 2
RT: Use weapon 3
B: Handbrake
Right analog stick: move camera
Y: rear view

A: Use turbo 
RB: Use the class's primary ability

View button: Player Ranking (Arcade only)
Menu button: Open the pause menu


EXPLORATION Controls (Story)

A: Move car/Select
Left analog stick: Move cursor
Right/left arrow: move camera right/left
Up/Down Arrow: Zoom in/out
Menu button: Open the pause menu
X: Pause the game


CUSTOMIZATION Controls (Menu > Garage)

D-pad Left-Right/Left Analog Stick: Car Rotation
A: Place/Remove Decoration
D-pad Up-Down: Zoom car
Left Analog Stick Click: Toggle UI
Right Analog Stick: Move decoration
LB + D-pad/Left Analog Stick: Rotate decoration
LB + X: Mirror decoration
RB + D-pad Left/Right: Scale decoration

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Campaign mode
notes.content:
Change the history of Zeranthia.
Take part in the chronicles of the kingdom of Zeranthia! At the end of the War of Wheels, the kingdom is subjugated by the Emperor, but combat vehicles have soon spread to all regions. Experience firsthand the events of the realm and be the first driver to change history!


 The realm of Zeranthia holds adrenaline-pumping and exciting events: experience them firsthand!


The entire kingdom is in your hands

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/700e7e31322b3eb9b6d5b6d2b497278eed75993a.gif

The realm has a very diverse terrain, and each region has distinctive villages and towns; scattered throughout the realm, moreover, are ancient ruins where the precious Aether can be obtained, but beware of vicious marauders lurking in the streets!


 Different types of terrain to explore;
 Each region features distinctive towns and villages;
 Search for the Aether in the remains of ancient ruins....
 Beware of lurking enemies: always be ready for a fight!


Visit outposts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/b2071da946033b032c66dbb4cea76577039e7434.gif

After a long journey, you will happen to stop by a small village, rather than a real province or even a 'mighty capital: you may meet citizens who can improve your vehicles and weapons, but also enlist valiant comrades-in-arms.


 Visit outposts to resupply yourself while traveling;
 Buy or manufacture new weapons;
 Improve the aesthetics and power of your vehicles;
 Recruit valiant war pilots.


Continuous battles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/706215d15292a157709f7ba7de0a757f03f4905a.gif

Some cities offer the chance to challenge other fighters in Gladiatorial Arenas, but numerous battles await you throughout the realm: you'll face fierce marauders in epic pitched battles or in the winding ruins to determine who gets the Aether.


 Take part in gladiatorial arena games;
 Fight pitched battles together with your army;
 Explore the ruins and challenge raiders to determine who will get the Aether.


The arcane crystals: Aether
Coming soon
Aether crystals are Zeranthia's main source of energy and wealth: they power vehicles and, through a refining process, greatly improve their performance on the road and give them unique abilities for combat.


 Aether is the main tool for obtaining wealth;
 By refining crystals, you can obtain upgrades for your vehicles;
 This mineral is able to endow vehicles with unique abilities.


Political deployments
Coming soon
The race for the Aether and the Emperor's hegemony have caused the emergence of factions also eager to gain power and riches-you can ally with a faction to gain valuable aid during your long journey.


 Ally with a faction to get unique improvements for your vehicles;
 By visiting your faction's outposts, you will gain access to additional benefits.
 You will be able to betray a faction and seek a new ally....


The world of Zeranthia is vast, full of pitfalls and intrigue--it will be up to you to write a crucial new chapter in its history!

notes.title: Arena: Gladiator Games
notes.content:
Dawn of Arenas
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/78ef624e3d284dc86424b2329b916e97b4d5014a.gif
After the conclusion of the bloody War of Wheels, there were numerous regions where general discontent spread; the Emperor of Zeranthia therefore instituted spectacular gladiatorial games, where daring war pilots could fight with their own vehicle in dangerous arenas.


 After the War of Wheels, arenas were born to compete in fierce vehicle battles.



Galvinor Arena
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/32bdd5b5231b0851826947b48166bbae8cb5c5f6.gif
The first arena established by the empire is that of Galvinor, whose statues and colonnades reflect the grandeur of the Empire; it consists of an upper floor, reachable via large ramps, and a lower floor, in the center of which is the enormous and sumptuous lion tower.


 Galvinor arena, built on two floors, symbolizes the pomp and power of the Empire.



Combat
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/cb3f9c01aa6c10802085384d569770597e2ef784.gif
Each battle is played between 8 war drivers who face each other within the time limit; the arena, full of ramps to speed along and obstacles to avoid (or destroy!), is also littered with fearsome traps, such as explosive barrels or fiery mouths of fire.


 Maximum of 8 vehicles participate in the gladiatorial games;
 The Arena has ramps, columns and obstacles (including destructible ones);
 Presence of traps, such as explosive barrels and cannons.



New arenas under construction!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/a7fd0778bf62ea96bbde86a1d9c787c5495f67eb.gif
Following the success of Galvinor's gladiatorial games, similar structures are springing up across the kingdom: each arena features unique paths and characteristic elements, as well as varying depending on the territory in which it is located.


 Each arena offers unique routes and structures that characterize it;
 The appearance of the arenas varies according to the different types of territory (city, arctic, volcanic, etc.).


Get on the track and take part in the gladiatorial games too... only in this way will you become the absolute champion of the entire kingdom!

Wishlist and Follow for more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337940/War_of_Wheels/?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=News&utm_content=arena

notes.title: Devlog: The Wheelsforge
notes.content:
A “stable” for war chariots
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/df123aac3f549c0ad94a5a2a8bc4c2eadc7a8b56.gif
After the advent of wheeled vehicles in Zeranthia, the blacksmiths of each region worked hard to create structures capable of providing every necessary service to the pilots of the kingdom: they are called Wheelsforge, real "stables” for combat vehicles.


 “Wheelsforge” are facilities where the best blacksmiths will turn your vehicles into real war chariots.



Choose your vehicle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/08c6bf8bc77fc6cc13519f07b98bfda43d245316.gif
Each Wheelforge can accommodate a multitude of different vehicles: here every brave war pilot will be able to choose his own vehicle from a vast assortment; blacksmiths can also use their skills to further improve components.


 In Wheelsforge you can change your vehicle, choosing from all those in your possession;
 Blacksmiths can improve the performance of each war chariot.



Equip your chariot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/abba988fc50961c20ec6173b3da65ab3f438e77d.gif
Each vehicle in your possession requires adequate equipment: it is in fact possible to mount up to 3 weapons on each vehicle, choosing from a vast arsenal that varies from one type of vehicle to another.


 Each vehicle boasts a loadout of 3 powerful weapons;
 The equipment available varies depending on the type of vehicle.



Decorations and aesthetics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/57cb52b023a0a0fda3f24dfc6afd895f58818a72.gif
If you are fed up with the bodywork of your vehicle, you need not fear: the Wheelsforge blacksmiths use particular pigments with which to coat your vehicles, so as to always show off an original aesthetic.


 You can change the colors of every vehicle you own.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337940/War_of_Wheels/

notes.title: Devlog: the Ranger
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/ec209aeb7d21ad778b143f346fc657dd88711560.gif

When the War of Wheels reaches its end, new factions rivaling the Emperor arose in the kingdom of Zeranthia; one of the first was that of the Rangers: inhabitants of the forests and skilled hunters, they took possession of the remains stolen from the battlefields to assemble their own hunting vehicle, extremely fast and able to dart easily over the most difficult terrain.


 The forests of Zeranthia are a hunting ground for numerous Ranger clans.


Gameplay

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/5eab9560c9eb2115e96f06eb3345e74b327aa88c.gif

Employ strategic maneuvers, hurtling through intricate and challenging courses.
Use long-range assault tactics to deliver powerful blows to opponents from a safe distance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/483016c1366821b257cdc0a82a024b0f20e055e5.gif

It is a vehicle that is not particularly resistant to impacts, but it is extremely agile and has high maneuverability.

The use of Aether also gives him the following abilities:
[olist]
 Survivor: The Ranger regains his vitality.
 Trap Master: The Ranger is immune to all traps.
[/olist]

In brief:

 Agile vehicle with high maneuverability;
 high ranged damage;
 Active Skill: Health Restoration
 passive ability: immunity to traps


Weapons

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/57cb52b023a0a0fda3f24dfc6afd895f58818a72.gif

Ranger clans possess an arsenal composed mainly of ranged weapons, perfect for a more tactical approach to combat;

it can mount 3 weapons: a frontal one, a pair of medium-range side weapons and a long-range one, mounted on top of its structure; Furthermore, he can choose between 2 sets of different weapons:

Set 1
[olist]
 Hunting Blades: rapid frontal weapon;
 Harpoon Shooter: it shoots darts at medium distance;
 Rifle: it strikes quickly at long range;
[/olist]

Set 2
[olist]
 Hunting Halberd: slow but lethal frontal weapon;
 Fires poisoned harpoons: it slowly corrodes affected vehicles;
 Crossbow: high damage at long range.
[/olist]

In brief:

 Prevalence of ranged weapons, some melee weapons;
 Two distinct weapon sets: the first includes faster weapons, the second slower but deadly weapons; both perfect for tactical approach.


If you are a traveler who enters the dense forests of Zeranthia you only have two choices: either you become a skilled Ranger... or you will become prey very soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337940/War_of_Wheels/

notes.title: Devlog: The Knight class
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/86eeb90da61ab051f2e09e1d07a358aaf22d273d.gif

When the Emperor of Zeranthia began the War of Wheels, he was joined by the venerated body of Knights; these noble warriors entered the annals of history as the first war pilots. Their majestic combat vehicle, a symbol of grandeur and elegance, reflects the implacable ferocity that dwells in the unyielding hearts of these valiant fighters.


 The Imperial Knights are the first war pilots to race across the lands of Zeranthia.


Gameplay

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/b7d8853e588f485e78518e753cca9286fed044a1.gif

It is a vehicle that adopts defensive tactics and exploits opponents' moments of weakness to push them back and return fire; He deals damage at close range, but when he charges, no one can resist his critical hits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/116396e0a455f9a7def0b4824720832433368bd6.gif

It is a balanced specimen, capable of reaching good speed and heavy enough to overwhelm opposing vehicles.

The use of Aether also gives him the following abilities:
[olist]
 Holy Shield: the Knight is invulnerable;
 Charge!: Spears, if drawn during a charge, deal enormous damage.
[/olist]

In short:

 Balanced vehicle, not too heavy nor too fast;
 close range damage, critical hits when charging;
 active skill: temporary invulnerability;
 passive skill: improved spear damage while charging.


Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/abba988fc50961c20ec6173b3da65ab3f438e77d.gif
The Knights have an arsenal worthy of their reputation, composed mainly of heavy sidearms;
it can mount 3 weapons: a frontal one, a pair of side weapons and a ranged one, mounted on top of its structure; furthermore, the war pilot can choose between two different sets of weapons:

Set 1

 Imperial blades: rapid melee weapon;
 Jousting spears: if unsheathed during a charge, they inflict considerable damage;
 Aether cannon: strikes from a distance with rapid projectiles imbued with magic

Set 2

 WarHammer: slow weapon, but mercilessly crushes anyone who comes before it;
 Morning stars:  they don't extend as far as spears, but they are much more lethal;
 Red-hot catapult: slow range weapon, its shots release hot flames on the unfortunate ones.


In short:

 Prevalence of melee weapons, some ranged weapons;
 Two distinct weapon sets: the first includes faster weapons, the second slower but devastating weapons.


Every province of Zeranthia trembles at the passage of the imperial army! If you prove yourself to be reckless enough... you too could become a formidable Knight.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337940/War_of_Wheels/

notes.title: Devlog: Game Overview
notes.content:
Hail to you, brave warrior!

Our Master Developers are hard at work building epic new arenas and adventures. You can expect a new kingdom to explore, taking part in an incredible adventure where you can explore the kingdom of Zeranthia and engage in fierce battles for control of Aether, the kingdom's powerful source of magic in crystal form.

●	an incredible medieval-punk setting
●	a vast medieval kingdom to explore, divided into varied realms
●	different cars with unique weapons and skills
●	new arenas in which to fight against other valiant  warriors

The War of Wheels begins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/05f3e0a2d509c8d6064ab46389992bedd6933b98.gif

Immerse yourself in a world where magic and cars merge in an incredible medieval punk adventure with the new story mode of War of Wheels. In this expanded world of Zeranthia, players can look forward to a gripping plot filled with unexpected twists, intrigues and unbridled action. Engage in epic battles, uncover hidden secrets, and navigate through a narrative that seamlessly weaves together the elements of magic and high-octane vehicular warfare. Get ready for an immersive journey where the boundaries of fantasy and technology blur, propelling you into the heart of the War of Wheels universe.

●	Live an epic war story in a medieval-punk setting

The Kingdom of Zeranthia

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/df43b66310016e05da10b0ce713a3e3cd3abea11.gif

In the demo you can compete in the Galvinor arena but there will be other places to test your fighting skills. 
Zeranthia’s territory offers a vast assortment of outposts to visit, ruins where you can mine Aether and lands in which to face enemy armies in epic pitched battles between war vehicles;
The first region offers a territory consisting of vast plains and dense forests, but in the future
you will also be able to see different landscapes, such as the glacial arctic realm and the scorching volcanic realm, each of which will present differences in the approach to exploration.

●	Explore the vast kingdom of Zeranthia, with its cities, its secrets and its epic battles

New vehicles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/08c6bf8bc77fc6cc13519f07b98bfda43d245316.gif

Legends of the streets are gearing up to make their mark in War of Wheels, bringing with them an impressive arsenal of new cars poised to wreak havoc on medieval battlefields. These street legends aren't just vehicles; they're powerful war machines customized for dominance. From sleek and agile models to hulking, heavily-armored beasts, you can choose your favorite ride, each with its unique attributes and capabilities.
In fact, each vehicle class draws inspiration from classic fantasy archetypes such as “Knight”, “Ranger” and more; this imaginative fusion ensures rich differentiation in playstyles, allowing you to embody the essence of your favorite class on battlefields: whether you choose the tenacious endurance of a knight-inspired war machine, the agility and precision reminiscent of a ranger or other fantastical roles, there's a vehicle tailored to suit your playstyle.

Each class is not only defined by its appearance and its stats but it’s also armed with a distinctive array of weaponry, inspired by real medieval weapons or reinterpreted in a technological and magical way: from close-quarter combat to long-range assaults, every war machine boasts a unique combination of melee and ranged weapons. 
The last distinctive element of each class is represented by the Skills, which forcefully break into the balance of the game to reverse the fate of the clashes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/6cffec637b50ed2474e1ed73a2cb8662fe2a4738.gif

Feel the might of medieval warfare as you engage enemies in fierce battles, strategically choosing your weapons to match your playstyle and outsmart your opponents!

●	Choose and race your vehicle! Choose the class with the weapons, skills and driving style that best suits you


Gladiatorial Arenas 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/ddb2868409ec59d348bb011719a30ce4e924cb71.gif

The excitement never wanes in War of Wheels, particularly in the wild arena fights, which promise endless thrills. Challenge the limits of your driving and fighting skills as you take on other warriors. In the current demo, a basic multiplayer mode is available, providing a glimpse into the adrenaline-fueled chaos that awaits; however, rest assured that we are diligently working on an upcoming update that will enhance your multiplayer experience, making it easier than ever to organize rooms with friends.

There are also exciting developments underway regarding the inclusion of new and diverse arenas, each featuring unique structural elements and requiring distinct playstyles. The formidable fighters of Zeranthia will be able to face each other in a total of four different realms, each full of challenges and opportunities (and dotted with treacherous obstacles and fearsome traps!).
Within each realm, competitors can choose from 4 arenas, for a total of 12 battlefields.

●	fight against other competitors in varied gladiatorial arenas

Feedback

The voice of Zeranthia’s valiant pilots is not just valued but absolutely crucial! We encourage you to actively share your gaming experiences, insightful suggestions, and constructive feedback in our dedicated Community Hub on Steam. Your input plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of this epic adventure and we are committed to fostering a collaborative environment where the community's voice is heard; together, we can elevate the gaming experience for everyone.

War winds blow, engines aflame! Prepare for epic strife!

Add to Wishlist and follow War of Wheels!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337940/

notes.title: DEMO pre-Alpha disponibile
notes.content:
Welcome to the War of Wheels pre-alpha Demo! War of Wheels is a fast-paced car combat game in an original "medievalpunk" setting.
In this demo it is possible to play a "Deathmatch" type game in single player versus facing bots, or in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players (bots will be inserted in the vacant positions).
New arenas and different game modes will be added soon and it will be possible to try a small portion of the Story mode.

START A MATCH
To start a game, select PLAY and choose SINGLE PLAYER DEATHMATCH or MULTIPLAYER DEATHMATCH. By selecting the first option the game will start immediately. By selecting the second one you will enter the Lobby. Even in this state you can continue to customize the car.

When you are ready, you can click on the circle next to the word "NOT READY" to change it to "READY". When all participants are ready, the host can start the game by pressing the START button. 

NOTE: at the moment it is not possible to change rooms, you will automatically be assigned to the first free and available one. It is possible to show the information of the room to which you are connected by pressing the "Room Info" debug button. However, it is possible to change the region of the room by pressing the "Change Region" debug button and selecting a new region.

CUSTOMIZE THE CAR
It is possible to select one of the available classes by pressing the GARAGE button from the top menu and clicking on the class icon. By selecting the CUSTOMIZE button it will be possible to change the weapons from the FUNCTIONS panel and the appearance from the COSMETICS panel. Each time a change is made, press SAVE to save the current configuration.

At any time you can press SHIFT + Right/Left Arrow to rotate the car (Xbox Controller: Press Right Analog Stick + Right/Left Arrow).
It is possible to add a custom decoration by clicking on "Custom" in the COSMETICS panel, choosing the decoration and placing it on the car. In positioning mode you can rotate the car by pressing Right/Left Arrow (Xbox Controller: Right/Left Arrow).
By clicking on the equipped decoration icon again you can remove it.

THE CLASSES
The currently playable classes are the Knight and the Ranger.

Knight: Balanced class, prefers close combat. His passive ability allows him to inflict massive damage on enemies when he strikes with his weapon of choice, spears, at high speeds (the spears begin to glow and leave a trail). His active ability allows him to protect himself, negating damage for a short period of time.
Ranger: Balanced class, prefers ranged combat. His passive ability makes him immune to traps. His active ability allows him to heal himself instantly.


NOTE: during combat it is possible to slash with a melee weapon by pressing the button corresponding to the weapon. If the button is held down, the weapon will be drawn and ready and will inflict damage when it comes into contact with an enemy. When a weapon is drawn you cannot attack with other weapons.

CHANGE THE OPTIONS
It is possible to change the graphic settings to better adapt the game to the PC in use (normal quality by default).
NOTE: It is currently not possible to change key assignments in the INPUT section.

IN-GAME CONTROLS
Using the controller is recommended for playing. The gamepad is currently not fully supported for menu navigation.

KEYBOARD
WASD: Move the car.
Left Mouse Button: Use Weapon 1
Middle Mouse Button: Use Weapon 2
Right Mouse Button: Use Weapon 3
Space: Handbrake

Left Shift: Use turbo (Feature in progress, not tested!)
Left CTRL: Use the Class's Primary Skill

Tab: Player Ranking
ESC: Open the pause menu

Debug Buttons:
J: UI toggle
K: Music toggle
L: SFX toggle
P: Self-destruction.

Have fun!
